corrections.subject: finance.STK_MONEY_FLOW class
corrections.receipt_detail: Exception: 所获取数据的权限类型未知 (unknown data permission type); this is NOT the paid-module text
corrections.consequence: the money_flow domain remains blocked because get_money_flow carries the explicit paid-module text; STK_MONEY_FLOW adds no paid evidence and must not be cited as such

corrections.subject: get_extras_paused
corrections.previous: counted as a security_state permission/capability failure
corrections.receipt_detail: Exception: 不支持的 info 参数：'paused'
corrections.evidence: get_price(paused) returned PERMISSION_OK in the same probe, so paused is available through get_price and security_state is not permission-limited
corrections.consequence: no paid denial, no account limitation; the paused route is get_price, not get_extras

The library stays a required target and the skip seal stays separate from the target
